scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Hm, I'm sorry if I made
a big scene when you grazed
me with that attack accidentally. It's just that I was training so
diligently and blood sugar was incredibly low and the fatigue...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
嗯，抱歉，剛才你不小心用攻擊蹭到了我，我可能反應有點過激。
只是我訓練得太刻苦了，加上低血糖和疲勞...

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Hah! Admit it,
old man! You were
just scared! Me, on
the other hand...
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
哈哈！承認吧，老頭子！你剛才只是被嚇到了！
而我呢...

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
You little
whippersnapper!
I don't know what
you're talking about!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
你這小鬼頭！
我不知道你在說什麼！

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
I recognize you
from somewhere,
I think. Reidin, do you
remember this guy?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
我覺得我好像在哪裡見過你。
雷丁，你記得這傢伙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Oh come on, we see
hundreds of Archers and
Hunters and Snipers and...
I can't remember them all.
But I guess this guy's up
to snuff. Trust me on this!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
哎呀，我們見過成百上千的弓箭手、獵人和神射手...
我怎麼可能都記得。
不過我覺得這傢伙挺厲害的。相信我！

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Alright, alright.
If Reidin thinks you're
worthy, then you're probably
are. In that case, I'd like to
offer to teach you my secret
skill, ''Phantasmic Arrow.''
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
好吧，好吧。
既然雷丁覺得你夠格，那你應該確實不錯。既然如此，我想傳授給你我的絕招，“幻影箭”。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Wait, wait. This guy
only needs a refresher.
Yeah, I'm pretty sure you
were here to learn this
skill before. Yeah, I've
got a gut feeling about it.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
等等，等等。這傢伙只需要複習一下。
沒錯，我相當確定你之前來過這裡學習這個技能。
沒錯，我有種預感。

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Damn. Only a refresher?
That means you'll learn
this free of charge. Alright...
You should be able to use the
Phantasmic Arrow skill now.
Travel safely now, you hear?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
該死。只是複習？
那意味著你可以免費學習。好吧...
你現在應該可以使用幻影箭技能了。
路上小心，聽到了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Hm? You're back?
Oh, did you bring
everything? Ah, you did.
Good! Now I shall reveal
my super secret skill...
The 1st Arpesto Form!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
嗯？你回來了？
哦，你把東西都帶齊了嗎？啊，帶了。
很好！那麼我要展示我的超級絕招了...
阿爾佩斯托第一式！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Wait! Wait...
Didn't you call it
Arpesto's 3rd Form
or something at first?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
等等！等等...
你剛才不是叫它阿爾佩斯托第三式之類的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Er, yes, Arpesto's
3rd Form, that's right.
It's just there's just so
many of them, that... 
Anyway, let me teach you
the ''Emergency Arrow'' skill.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
呃，是的，阿爾佩斯托第三式，沒錯。
只是招式太多了，所以...
總之，讓我教你“緊急箭”技能。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Whoa, hold on!
''Emergency Arrow?!''
That's the old name you
gave that skill, right?
Didn't you change it?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
哇，等一下！
“緊急箭”？！
那是你以前給那個技能起的名字，對吧？
你不是改過名字嗎？

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
What the hell
are you talkin--
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
你他媽在說什--

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Oh, you're right.
We agreed that name
was too cheesy. What
did we call it now? Um...
''Phantasmic Arrow?''
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
哦，你說得對。
我們之前同意那個名字太俗了。那現在我們叫它什麼來著？嗯...
“幻影箭”？

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Umm....
Ummm........

[Reidin Corse]
Yeah, that was the one!
''^3131FFPhantasmic Arrow^000000'' sounds
soooo much cooler than that
other name you came up with!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
沒錯，就是那個！
“^3131FF幻影箭^000000”聽起來比你之前想的那個名字酷多了！

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
You can be pretty handy
sometimes, Reidin. Now,
back to the matter at hand.
I shall teach you my awesome
skill, Phantasmic Arrow. Now...
Ready your mind and body!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
雷丁，你有時候還挺有用的。好了，回到正題。
我要教你我的強力技能，幻影箭。那麼...
準備好你的身心吧！

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Phan-!
Ta-!
Ssssss-!
Mic-!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
Phan-!
Ta-!
Ssssss-!
Mic-!

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
ARRRRRRRROOOOOOW~!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
ARRRRRRRROOOOOOW~!

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
^333333*Pant Pant*^000000
Alright, I used a special
technique to teach you the
skill-- directly into your brain. You should be able to use it
now. Why don't give it a try?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
^333333*呼哧呼哧*^000000
好了，我用了一種特殊技巧，把技能直接灌進了你的大腦。你現在應該可以使用它了。不如試試看？

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Swwwwwww!*
*Bang!*^000000

[Arpesto]
^333333*Pant Pant*
*Cough Cough*
*Cough Cough*^000000

[Arpesto]
WHHHHHHHY MEEEEE?!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
為什...為什麼是我？！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Ar-Arpesto, no!
...........................
Oh. Oh, come on! The arrow
just glanced you! You'll be
alright. Quit being a baby.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
阿-阿爾佩斯托，不！
...........................
哦。哦，拜託！箭只是擦過你而已！
你沒事的。別像個嬰兒一樣大驚小怪。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Eh, don't worry about
Arpesto. He's just being
a crazy old man. I'll take
care of him, so just make
sure you make good use
of that new skill. Take care~
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
呃，別擔心阿爾佩斯托。
他只是個瘋老頭。我會照顧他的，你只要好好利用那個新技能就好。再見~

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Hurry up and bring
^3131FF5 Cursed Rubies^000000,
^3131FF30 Pet Foods^000000 and
^3131FF5 Harpy Feathers^000000.
Then, I can teach you
the Emergency Arrow skill.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
快點給我帶來^3131FF5顆詛咒紅寶石^000000、^3131FF30份寵物飼料^000000和^3131FF5根哈比的羽毛^000000。
然後，我就可以教你緊急箭技能了。

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Ah, very nice.
Um, as you demonstrated
earlier, my teaching technique
was perfect. But next time, use
the skill on foes that deserve
to be beaten, alright? Good.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
啊，非常好。
嗯，正如你剛才展示的那樣，我的教學技巧是完美的。但下次，請對那些該被打敗的敵人使用這個技能，好嗎？很好。

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Did the master send you
to me? Hmm... You're still
pretty green from the looks
of it. Yeah, I don't think there's anything I can teach quite yet.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
是師父派你來的嗎？嗯...
看你的樣子，經驗還不足。
是的，我覺得我暫時沒什麼可以教你的。

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Train a little more and get
some more experience in
your job. When you become
more adept at hunting, you'll
be able to grasp what I've been
teaching Hunters and Snipers.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
多訓練一下，在你的職業上多積累一些經驗。
當你狩獵技巧更加嫻熟時，你就能掌握我教給獵人和神射手的技巧了。

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Has the master sent you?
Ah, you definitely have the
keen, vulture like eyes of a
true Hunter. You should be
capable of learning my secret
skill, the 3rd Arpesto Form...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
是師父派你來的嗎？
啊，你絕對擁有一雙真正的獵人那銳利如禿鷲般的眼睛。
你應該有能力學習我的秘密技能，阿爾佩斯托第三式...

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
It's a handy skill that
I developed while battling
Medusas and running out
of arrows. I simply call it,
''^3131FFEmergency Arrow^000000.'' Would you
be interested in learning it?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
這是一個實用的技能，是我在與米杜沙戰鬥時箭矢用盡後開發出來的。我簡單地稱之為“^3131FF緊急箭^000000”。你願意學習它嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, please!
scripts.translation: 好的，請教我！

scripts.text: Ummm...

[Arpesto]
Great, great. Of course,
you can't resist this offer
if you recognize this skill's
value. However, I'd like to
ask for a little tuition in return for me teaching this to you.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
很好，很好。當然，如果你認識到這個技能的價值，你就無法拒絕這個提議。不過，我想在教你這個技能的同時，收取一點學費。

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Although I feel guilt at
asking for payment from
a fellow Hunter, creating
this skill required much
sacrifice and unimaginable
bloodshed on my part...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
雖然向同為獵人的你收取費用讓我感到愧疚，但創造這個技能需要我付出巨大的犧牲和難以想像的鮮血...

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Hey! You liar!
I was there when you
accidently made up that
skill when you were bored
and just messing around
with one of the Bows!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
嘿！你這個騙子！
我親眼看到你無聊時胡亂擺弄一把弓，不小心發明了那個技能！

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
^333333*Ahem*^000000 Please Reidin,
don't entertain unfounded
rumors. It was only after
countless battles with Eddga
that I managed to invent and
perfect Emergency Arrow.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
^333333*咳咳*^000000拜託了，雷丁，不要傳播沒有根據的謠言。
正是在與虎王無數次戰鬥後，我才發明並完善了緊急箭。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
^333333*Tsk tsk*^000000 Huh.
I thought you said
you developed it while
you were fighting Medusas.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
^333333*嘖*^000000哼。
我還以為你說你是在和米杜沙戰鬥時開發出來的呢。

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
A-anyway, please bring
me the following items
as tuition in exchange for
me teaching you this skill.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
不-不管怎樣，請給我帶來以下物品，作為我教你這個技能的學費。

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Please bring me
^3131FF5 Cursed Rubies^000000,
^3131FF30 Pet Foods^000000 and
^3131FF5 Harpy Feathers^000000.
Then I can teach
you this skill.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
請給我帶來^3131FF5顆詛咒紅寶石^000000、^3131FF30份寵物飼料^000000和^3131FF5根哈比的羽毛^000000。
這樣我就可以教你這個技能了。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
30 Pet Foods?
What the heck do
you need all that for?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
30份寵物飼料？
你要那麼多幹什麼？

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
I...
I'm going to
use it to feed
my pet Falcon.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
我...
我要用它來餵我的寵物獵鷹。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
...
......
.........
......Riiiight.

[Arpesto]
Alright, it's your
decision. However, I'm
sure that you may have
great need of my skill
sooner or later, so return
to me if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
好吧，這是你的決定。不過，我相信你遲早會非常需要我的技能，如果你改變主意了，就回來找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
The sky still looks clear, but recently the winds that have been blowing through the land seem to carry with them an air of misfortune.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
天空看起來依然晴朗，但最近吹過這片土地的風，似乎帶著不祥的氣息。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
So...
Danger's coming?
Heh! Chill, gramps~
I got it covered!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
所以...
危險要來了？
嘿！別擔心，老爺爺~
交給我吧！

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Ho ho...
Energetic, but
cocky. Kids nowadays...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
呵呵...
精力充沛，但有點自大。現在的年輕人...
